properties.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 14 at 5:08AM ChST until November 14 at 4:00PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 7 to 9 feet in the surf zone.
Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...North facing reefs of the Marianas.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM ChST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion. Rip currents can sweep even the best
swimmers away from shore into deeper water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The long-period north swell that originated
from Typhoon Cempaka has most likely peaked yesterday, but could
take time to subside. Therefore, large surf and dangerous rip
currents will likely continue through this afternoon.
properties.instruction:
Rip currents will be life threatening. Inexperienced swimmers
should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions.

Rip currents will be life threatening. If caught in a rip
current, relax and float. Don't swim against the current. If
able, swim in a direction following the shoreline. If unable to
escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.

NWSheadline: HIGH SURF ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 4 PM CHST THIS AFTERNOON... ...HIGH RISK OF RIP CURRENTS UNTIL 4 PM CHST THIS AFTERNOON
